'''''Imperial Protector''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]]. It was destroyed in the [[ambush on Ral's Run]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]].
